sentences.en: There are a handful of naughty boys in my neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我邻里的顽童只有少数几个。

sentences.en: Only a handful of activists are articulate in our union.
sentences.zh: 我们工会里只有少数几位活动分子口才很好。

sentences.en: Only a handful of men want to take childcare leave.
sentences.zh: 只有极少数男性愿意请育儿假。

senses.zh: 少数，少量,一把（的量）,难以控制的人（或动物）,棘手事
